data.notes: Cape Town’s November calendar leans into summer rooftop and beach parties, Afro-house/Amapiano club culture, contemporary jazz, and major international soul/R&B concerts.

events.title: Leon Bridges Presents: The Happiness Anytime Tour – Cape Town
events.summary: Leon Bridges brings The Happiness Anytime Tour to Kirstenbosch Concert Area for an outdoor Cape Town date. SANBI bills the show as a contemporary R&B performance at Kirstenbosch, with the concert running from 18:00 to 22:00.

events.title: Jill Scott – To Whom This May Concern World Tour
events.summary: GRAMMY-winning R&B and neo-soul artist Jill Scott brings her To Whom This May Concern World Tour to Grand Arena. The venue page bills the Cape Town show as the grand finale of the South Africa run.

events.title: DESCENDANTS: CAPE TOWN
events.summary: New York-born international event and label DESCENDANTS makes its Cape Town debut with a two-stage Castle of Good Hope takeover spanning Afro Tech, 3-Step, Deep House, Gqom and Amapiano, with Culoe De Song, Funky QLA, Soa Mattrix, Dwson and Thandi Draai among the lineup.

events.title: Love + Friends | Beach Edition
events.summary: Love+Friends returns to Cabo Beach Club for a beach-side summer opener. The confirmed lineup includes Vanco, Enoo Napa and Phee, with additional acts listed by the promoter.

events.title: Dance Dance
events.summary: Afro house and Afro tech night at Biblio featuring Mobi Dixon, Ziddo, 2Burna and a broader local lineup for a strong club-focused genre bill.

events.title: Born2HouseMusic - Playhouse x Beyond Audio Album Tour
events.summary: Born2House Music links with Sculptured Sundays for a deep and soulful house album-tour day party celebrating Sculptured Music’s Playhouse and DJ Nana’s Beyond Audio.

events.title: Chasing Sunsets
events.summary: A rooftop house-music session at Paradise Rooftop in District Six, billed around Afro House, deep house, private-school Amapiano and hip-hop/R&B singalongs. The page lists the headliner and support lineup as still TBA.

events.title: Kwaafro
events.summary: Afro-house and Afro-tech party at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock. The listed lineup includes Digital Sangoma, Rudy Julius, 2Burna, Keegs, Vee SoDeep, Mafaku, Luu DJ, Gnice and Kayg.

events.title: For The Culture
events.summary: Deep house and amapiano night at Colorbox Studios with SGVO, Chronical Deep, Siwa, Luu Deep and other selectors on the bill.

events.title: THE LOFT
events.summary: Recurring deep-house community night at Hearty Collective, billed as an underground celebration of deep house with immersive lighting, decor and a limited-capacity dancefloor.

events.title: The Gateway
events.summary: State Alchemy takes over all of Biblio for a 12-hour, three-floor underground electronic event covering psytrance, tech and drum & bass, with 18 acts and Johannesburg guests.

events.title: That's What She Said ft. Tune Raider, Ethereal & Friends
events.summary: All-female underground DJ night at Botanik Social House, promoted with Psy Sisters support and a two-dancefloor lineup led by Tune Raider and Ethereal.

events.title: Dimension X
events.summary: A psytrance and progressive-trance night at Alley in Paarden Eiland. The confirmed lineup includes Symo, Tall Tales, Deadlock, Rubix Qube and Dranged.

events.title: Mystika
events.summary: Club Paradise night listed for house, Afro house, Afro tech and 3-Step, placing it in the city’s Afro-electronic weekend circuit.

events.title: Ses'Fikile
events.summary: Ses'Fikile takes over Texas in District Six with a sound listed across house, deep house, Afro-house, Afro-tech, gqom and Amapiano. The event is part of the city’s late-month club calendar.

events.title: Miriam Altman – The Butterfly Project Live in Cape Town
events.summary: Jazz vocalist, songwriter and producer Miriam Altman presents The Butterfly Project with an ensemble of South African jazz musicians. The concert is billed as contemporary vocal jazz with soul, poetry and African rhythmic influences.

events.title: Summer Sundowner hosted by Aden Thomas
events.summary: Aden Thomas hosts an afternoon DJ-led summer sundowner on the lawns of Protea Hotel Mowbray. The listed DJs are Kevin Petersen, Theo on the Throne, Che, Denver A, Jade Scholtz and Jay.L.A.

events.title: Nayma Rias Presents: Red Reloaded – The Live Experience
events.summary: Nayma Rias presents an intimate live version of Red Reloaded with music, conversation and visual art at Mamakashaka & Friends. The event page lists Nayma Rias as the performer and marks the show sold out.

events.title: Meidum: A Mountain Oasis 2026
events.summary: Meidum is a confirmed 27–29 November 2026 electronic camping festival at Pat Busch Mountain Reserve near Robertson, described by the organiser as two hours outside Cape Town. The event is built around a large pyramid-style dance stage with camping included in tickets.
